description: First-boot provisioning for the Windows-compatible shape's WINE path: start from a minimal Ubuntu base ISO and install the Wine compatibility layer plus its runtime libraries via apt on first boot. This is the light alternative to baking a compiled artifact into the ISO (see windows/build-shape.sh). Wine runs on the Linux base, so apt is the correct provisioner. The ReactOS path is NOT apt-provisionable (see windows/provision/reactos.provision.json) and must be built/baked.

packages.name: wine
packages.reason: Windows application compatibility layer (clean-room Win32/Win64 API).

packages.name: fonts-liberation
packages.reason: Metric-compatible free substitute for Arial/Times/Courier (no Microsoft fonts shipped).

firstBoot: echo 'Windows (Wine) shape provisioned via apt on first boot.'
